nodes.label: required-sections Sensor
nodes.rationale: Default mode is a deliberately generic content-shape floor (at least two H2 headings) because the framework ships no per-stage heading overrides; teams introduce specific shapes via a template file or the learning loop when there is a real reason.

nodes.label: Template-Override Layer
nodes.rationale: Two override paths with fixed precedence: a resolving memory/templates/<artifact>.md wins over a '## Sensors'-prose override. The file-driven path is preferred because the same template is the skeleton the agent fills, so the produced shape and the checked shape cannot drift; the check passes iff expected headings are a subset of the output and names the missing ones as precise advisory findings. Templates apply only to template-eligible prose artifacts - one resolving for a questions or timestamp marker is ignored with a config warning and the marker keeps the generic floor.

nodes.label: units YAML Edge Block
nodes.rationale: For unit-of-work-dependency.md the sensor additionally requires the fenced yaml units: block to be present, well-formed and cycle-free, reporting ok/absent/malformed/cyclic; anything but ok fails at the gate specifically so a malformed DAG never reaches the runtime compiler that parses it into the batch fan-out.
